Level 17 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Fighting Style feature or Unarmored Defense feature
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 2+ (see below)
Order: Recruit

Here you plan military actions with an inner circle of loyal lieutenants, each a battle-hardened Veteran Warrior of your alignment. You start with two lieutenants. If your Bastion has no room to house them, they lodge at the nearest inn or settlement. Lieutenants are hirelings, not Bastion Defenders, but if your Bastion is attacked, each lieutenant housed there reduces by 1 the number of dice you roll to see how many defenders are lost. The room holds war memorabilia and a large table with chairs for you and your lieutenants.

Recruit Options. When you issue the Recruit order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Recruit: Lieutenant. You gain one new lieutenant, up to ten at any time.

Recruit: Soldiers. One or more lieutenants each muster one hundred Guards in 7 days (or twenty Guards mounted on Riding Horses) to fight for your cause. Feeding each guard and horse costs 1 GP per day. Wherever it goes, the army must be led by you or a lieutenant, or it disbands at once; it also disbands after 1 day without food. Otherwise it remains until destroyed or disbanded, and you can't issue this order again until then.
